# Vehicle Version 3 sizing (generated by tools/vehicle_sizing/v3_sizing.py)

Stated first-order estimates, not validated data. Version 2 is evaluated with the same physics for comparison. Note that the Version 2 *simulation* deliberately uses much higher glide drag, tuned for a ~3 m/s demo top speed.

## Version 3 checks against the agreed targets

- [PASS] Top speed ≥ 50 km/h in calm conditions: 86 km/h
- [PASS] Cruise 30 km/h into a 5 m/s headwind: top speed into the wind 74 km/h
- [PASS] Static thrust ≥ 15 % of weight (gets over the hump with margin): 0.18
- [PASS] Cushion pressure within 0.5–1.5 kPa: 0.99 kPa
- [PASS] Genset (20 kW) covers 50 km/h continuously: 11.1 kW

## Tracks

Tracks capped at 15 km/h: about 3.2 kW electrical with 60% cushion load share. Speed comes from hovering, not from the tracks.

## Turning at speed

Turn radius = v² / (μ_lat g). μ_lat is the sideways force the craft can make (skirt side drag, rudders, puff ports) divided by its weight.

| μ_lat | 10 km/h | 30 km/h | 50 km/h |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0.10 (rudders + puff ports, as Version 2) | 8 m | 71 m | 197 m |
| 0.20 (plus skegs / skirt shift) | 4 m | 35 m | 98 m |
